annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five people facing certain death, against a track that by every available sign was empty
annotations.pd_harm_distress: still sits heavy in my chest
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd be sorry about that death for a long time
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: A backup sensor would likely have caught it.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: They weighed five lives against what looked like none
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd carry real sorrow for the person my switch sent the train toward
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have built in a fault alarm
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: that worker never seeing it coming

annotations.pd_harm_distress: bothers me more than I expected
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd wish again and again I hadn't been the one

annotations.pd_harm_distress: I felt a bit shaky reading about the person
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd be sorry for their death, no question
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have installed a second, independent track sensor

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: five lives were saved by a sound decision
annotations.pd_harm_distress: a death like this gets under my skin
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd grieve the person on that siding
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: Daily self-checks by maintenance might have exposed the fault
annotations.sys_rule_justification: You trust your instruments or you can't do the job
Blame needs some access to the facts, and they had none.
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd hold real regret for killing them
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: track workers could carry location beacons

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Saving five when the alternative seemed to harm nobody
annotations.pd_harm_distress: it still hits me to think of that person
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd feel sorrow about what my choice did to them
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: Management could have known exactly who was out there.

annotations.pd_harm_distress: makes me feel a little sick
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd be sorry for the one who died because of my switch
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I'd still choose five over one I couldn't see
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: designers should make the display show 'no data' when it fails

annotations.ce_understood_harm: someone went to work and didn't come home
annotations.pd_harm_distress: that knot in my throat hasn't quite gone
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd live with sorrow for them
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have had a spotter or a camera covering the siding

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: waiting and losing five people for certain
annotations.pd_harm_distress: painful for me, a real ache
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd be sorry for their death while standing by the decision
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have required redundant occupancy detection
